summary.sub: Google的新中档模型、OpenAI自曝的芯片设计成绩、dots从高价套餐往下放，均用公司原文加独立媒体核对。

items.t: Gemini 4 Neon上线API和Gemini App，每百万token输入3美元、输出15美元，1M上下文，夹在Hydrogen和Carbon之间
OpenAI称模型改写AMD旗舰GPU IP的RTL代码，PPA最多提升14%，部分改动已进流片设计；数字为自报
ChatGPT dots开始给少量Plus用户测试，欧洲经济区、英国、瑞士除外；美国Business Standard同步开放

oneline.text: 定位在Hydrogen和Carbon之间，Google称默认档位下每个任务成本比Carbon低32%。

bullets.v: 11月18日起在Gemini API、Antigravity和Gemini App推出，App端限AI Pro和Ultra订阅。
1M上下文，缓存输入每百万0.15美元；Carbon促销价11月30日结束后，Neon比它便宜25%。
跑分全是Google自报。中等难度的代码和Agent任务，可以拿自己的用例和Carbon对比一遍。

sourceEvidence.quote: Gemini 4 Neon is rolling out today in the Gemini API in Google AI Studio
$15 per million output tokens, with a 1 million-token context window.
At its default high thinking level, it pairs a high Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index score with a 32% lower cost per task than Carbon.
Neon is priced at $3/1M input tokens and $15/1M output tokens, or twice as expensive as Hydrogen.
After the promotional pricing, it will be $4/1M input and $20/1M output, with Neon 25% cheaper as a result.

title.text: OpenAI模型改写AMD GPU电路，PPA最多+14%

oneline.text: 模型改写SystemVerilog RTL代码，再用Synopsys工具验证行为不变，部分改动已进流片设计。

bullets.v: OpenAI称在AMD旗舰GPU IP上，相对高度优化的基线，PPA最多提升14%，用时不到5个月。
芯片设计里最耗人力的RTL优化开始交给模型，AMD下一代CPU关键模块也有个位数提升。
14%是模块级最好成绩，基线没公开，GPU也没有成品芯片实测，两家还有资本关系。

sourceEvidence.quote: seen up to 14% improvement relative to heavily optimized baselines on the flagship GPU IP
Our model identified further improvements by rewriting the code that describes the chip’s circuits (SystemVerilog RTL).
AMD has already included some of these changes in a recent design it sent for manufacturing
AMD also verified single-digit percentage gains in PPA across key blocks of its upcoming next-generation flagship CPU
OpenAI has not published the block-level baselines
delivered roughly a year of chip-design progress in less than five months

oneline.text: 常驻Agent从Pro和企业版往下放，先给少量Plus用户，欧洲经济区、英国、瑞士不在范围内。

bullets.v: OpenAI向部分Plus用户灰度推出dots，美国Business Standard成员同步开放，有用量限制。
dots是能跨对话持续推进任务的Agent，此前只在Pro、Business Premium和企业版。
澳洲不在排除名单里，但属于随机灰度，客服没法手动开通；Plus用量额度还没公布。

sourceEvidence.quote: Your dot is an always-on agent in ChatGPT that can take on ongoing responsibility
selected Plus users aged 18 and older in markets excluding the European Economic Area, Switzerland, and the UK.
Dots are rolling out to eligible ChatGPT Business Standard members in the United States.
Starting January 14, 2027, billing begins for all enabled dots.
It's not yet clear whether ChatGPT Plus and Business Standard users will have the same Dots usage allowances

mp.title: Gemini 4 Neon定价3美元，OpenAI模型改AMD芯片电路，ChatGPT dots开测Plus
